playstyle.identity: Jarvan IV is a versatile engage jungler who traps enemies in his arena. His flag-drag combo makes him a reliable ganker with knockup engage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive deals bonus damage on first hit per target. Q is a skillshot that pulls you to your flag and knocks up. W slows around you and shields. E throws a flag giving attack speed. R creates impassable terrain trapping enemies inside. E-Q combo for knockup engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Jarvan spikes at level 2 with E-Q combo and level 6 with arena trap. He's strong at ganking and teamfight engage throughout.

passive.name: Martial Cadence
passive.summary: First auto on each enemy deals bonus damage based on their current health.
passive.details: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current health. Has a cooldown per target.

abilities.name: Dragon Strike
abilities.summary: Thrust your lance; if it hits your flag, dash to it and knock up enemies.
abilities.details: Jarvan extends his lance in a line, dealing damage and reducing armor. If it passes through his flag, he dashes to it, knocking up enemies in his path.

abilities.name: Golden Aegis
abilities.summary: Shield based on nearby enemies and slow them.
abilities.details: Jarvan shields himself, with the shield increasing for each nearby enemy champion. Nearby enemies are also slowed.

abilities.name: Demacian Standard
abilities.summary: Throw a flag that gives attack speed; combo with Q to dash.
abilities.details: Jarvan throws a flag that deals damage on impact. The flag grants attack speed to nearby allies and acts as a target for Q's dash.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.summary: Leap to an enemy and create impassable terrain around you.
abilities.details: Jarvan leaps to an enemy champion, dealing damage and creating a circle of impassable terrain. Champions can use dashes to escape.
